profile.name: Dheeraj Jha
profile.title: DevOps Engineer | Cloud Systems | Explorer at Heart
profile.bio: I build scalable infrastructure, enjoy thoughtful problem-solving, and explore ideas beyond code.

experience.description: Initiating as Sr System Engineer, working on range of DevOps assignments mostly containing AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Jenkins, Kafka etc.

Provided architectural solutions to small and medium infrastructure, effectively scaling costs. Identified pain points in infrastructure by understanding process flow and provided simple, use-case based solutions. Optimized different applications based on their specific use-cases. Streamlined CI/CD by setting up pipelines using Github Actions or Gitlab-ci. Diversified infrastructure by utilizing various AWS services tailored to specific use-cases. Set up logging, monitoring, and auto-recovery using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Ansible, and CloudWatch.

Successfully migrated the entire operation to AWS, resulting in the establishment of a highly scalable infrastructure. Streamlined cloud and internal processes, leading to cost savings of 40-50% while effectively scaling operations. Achieved a 95% reduction in processing time by implementing a fully automated data processing system. Developed and implemented in-house central dashboards, resulting in time savings of 10-15 hours per developer and improving overall productivity by 30-40%. Enhanced API and Web Dashboard performance by 60-80%.
Led software development team. Technologies: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Linux System Administration, Team Leadership, Vue.js, Continuous Integration (CI), Git, PHP.

Successfully delivered the Mobi-hub platform. Planned, hired, and led a team of 15+ professionals. Increased scalability of the Magento application by optimizing traffic and speed using AWS resources. Developed an in-house inventory management system for B2B and B2C applications. Implemented a multi-tenant architecture.
Fullstack web development. Skills: Linux System Administration, JavaScript, MySQL, AJAX, Git.

Took charge of the entire IT infrastructure and formulated a growth-oriented plan. Mastered various cloud platforms such as Digital Ocean, Cloudways, and AWS. Boosted sales and improved customer satisfaction by creating online analytics tools. Optimized research procedures, resulting in a 5-fold increase in customer delivery.

Initiated a shift in development methodology from Core PHP to a framework-based approach. Innovated in-house tools to boost productivity and established coding libraries, leading to a 30% acceleration in development processes. Contributed to several products and implemented an in-house CMS, resulting in a 60-70% reduction in project delivery time.
